scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @barberflow/api" "npm run dev -w @barberflow/web"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c green,yellow,cyan "npm run db:local" "npm run dev -w @barberflow/api" "npm run dev -w @barberflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @barberflow/api && npm run build -w @barberflow/web
